x: Rules set by Chris: choco-banana, size circles, Dutch Chocolate (difference ≥ 4), nabner bananas, no givens, normal sudoku.

No chocolate rectangle has a side longer than 4. The cells just past a side of 5 or more form one straight banana group of 5 or more cells: exactly 5 is the I-pentomino, a rectangle, and more than 5 breaks nabner. So a long side must lie on the board edge, which forces the whole 9x9 board; that has 0 fillings with boxes, and any circle rules it out too. Argument by Chris.

Difference-4 rectangle catalogue built (#760). Every shape up to 3x3 and up to 2x4 is enumerated in full. 3x4 and 4x4 without boxes and 4x4 at box offset (1,1) stopped at a 100,000 fill-count cap; their digit domains and circle cells come from exact CP-SAT solves. Full counts: 3x4 = 139,524, 4x4 (1,1) = 200,400, 4x4 = 2,107,212. Since #767 (merged as 88a4902), every layer with both sides at most 4 is enumerated in full in the catalogue.
